value.title: PDF RFC 9111: HTTP Caching - Internet Engineering Task Force
value.snippet: Note that in previous specifications, heuristically cacheable response status codes were called "cacheable by default". If the response has a Last-Modified header field ( Section 8.8.2 of [HTTP] ), caches are encouraged to use a heuristic expiration value that is no more than some fraction of the interval since that time.
